title: Boolean parity sign
statement: For a subset $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ and $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$, define the parity sign on $S$ to be $\prod_{i\in S}x_i$, regarded as a unit of the integers.
